verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect support. Serverless autoscales resources to actual usage and contracts after spikes (elastic-docs-7, elastic-docs-33), and self-managed or on-prem deployment is an option (elastic-docs-13, elastic-docs-45), which implies infrastructure-based rather than per-request costs. No pricing documentation shows how costs scale with records or query volume. Community reports of 'nickel and diming', licensing fees eating project profits, unclear subscription tiers and an expensive SaaS (elastic-comm-1, elastic-comm-7, elastic-comm-14, elastic-comm-15) undercut the predictability claim. Missing for 10: documented pricing model for storage and query volume, explicit absence of per-request charges, cost caps or budget controls on serverless, independent evidence of predictable bills at scale.
